author: AtditC
body:
Hello Avicus Staff members.

Another report:

Name of player being reported: Xenocius
Rule broken: Rudeness
Evidence: https://i.imgur.com/Zx9QHLJ.png https://pastebin.com/Ey7sWr0M
Anything else you would like to add? He was verbally warned like ~5 minutes before the screenshot for rudeness. ("Be nice"). Also, the Mod Lettucai didn't warn or verbally warn Xenocius again. Lettucai was in Lobby1 at this moment (I think) and you can still see the ban message because I toggled punishment messages to global. He also logged off after saying "fuckers xd".

Greetings,
-Atdit
